name: Away
source:
You play as a woman desperate to reconnect with a past she can no longer grasp. In search of answers, she is pulled into a surreal voyage across parallel worlds – each one stranger, darker, and more dangerous than the last.

In the shadows of these dimensions, she meets a mysterious witch who offers her a chance to change her destiny. But such power always comes at a cost…

Along the way, she is drawn to four very different gentlemen, each carrying secrets of their own.

[From [url=https://miliag.itch.io/away]Itch.io[/url]]
